name: 19971 · Rehoboth Bch, DE
findings: ZIP 19971 (Rehoboth Bch) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19971 (Rehoboth Bch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19971 (Rehoboth Bch) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
